# proprietary-files.txt - Meizu M3 Note CN (m681), MT6755
#
# PROVENANCE (FACT): copied unmodified on 2026-09-16 from
#   /srv/forge/android/meizu_m6/rom-lineage-15.1-meizu_m6-experimental/vendor/meizu/m681/proprietary-files.txt
# which was auto-generated by mt6755_tree_stage from the stock Flyme 6.2.0.2A
# /system/vendor tree unpacked at /srv/forge/android/m681/Flyme6.2.0.2A/.
# That stock image is Android 7.0 / API 24
#   (ro.build.fingerprint=Meizu/meizu_m3note/m3note:7.0/NRD90M/1510540088:user/release-keys),
# so EVERY blob listed below is a Nougat-era MTK binary. That is the root
# reason this tree is non-Treble and carries no BOARD_VNDK_VERSION.
#
# NOT YET DONE (honest status):
#   - extract-files.sh / setup-makefiles.sh have NOT been re-run for LOS20, so
#     there is no vendor/meizu/m681 makefile tree in this workspace. device.mk
#     uses inherit-product-if-exists so the tree builds without it.
#   - This list has NOT been audited against Android 13. Many entries (the
#     vendor/app/* APKs, the Nougat HIDL-less RIL stack, the camera blobs) are
#     known-dead or known-broken on A13 and will need pruning.
#   - The camera blobs in particular back a subsystem that does not work even
#     on the shipping 4.4 kernel (M681_DAILY_DRIVER_STATUS.md row 15).
#
# Auto-generated from mt6755_tree_stage.
# Clean up entries only after the first bring-up succeeds.
#
# BLOB AUDIT 2026-09-16 (fleet hygiene pass): 19 LINES REMOVED BELOW — they
# named AOSP code that Android 13 builds from source in this very workspace.
#
# Nothing was removed on the strength of a file name.  Every blob was read
# with `strings` and matched against the AOSP source that is still in this
# tree; the Android-13 side comes from the install rules Soong actually wrote
# for a real product of this workspace
# (/srv/forge/android/los20-out/out-m95/soong/installs-lineage_m95.mk, from
# `m nothing` for lineage_m95, rc=0).
#
# GROUP 1 — SAME DESTINATION PATH.  A PRODUCT_COPY_FILES rule for these would
# silently beat the built module: the copy rule is emitted from
# build/make/core/Makefile:72 and wins over the module rule
# (base_rules.mk:533 / installs-<product>.mk), which is the exact mechanism
# that replaced a source-built hwcomposer with a blob on the m5c.  9 lines:
#
#   lib{,64}/hw/audio.a2dp.default.so
#     A13 builds packages/modules/Bluetooth/system/audio_a2dp_hw/
#     audio.a2dp.default and installs it to system/lib{,64}/hw/ — the same
#     path.  FACT: the blob is AOSP's own source, it carries the literal path
#     "system/bt/audio_a2dp_hw/audio_a2dp_hw.c" and hw_module_t .name
#     "A2DP Audio HW HAL"; MediaTek's whole delta is a debug dump
#     ("mtk.a2dp.pcmdump", "/sdcard/mtklog/btlog/bt_audio.pcm").  Its
#     A2DP_CTRL_CMD_* socket protocol is the Nougat one, so it could not work
#     against the A13 stack even if it won the race.
#
#   lib{,64}/hw/camera.default.so
#     A13 builds hardware/libhardware/modules/camera/3_0/camera.default into
#     system/lib{,64}/hw/ — the same path.  FACT: the blob is verbatim that
#     source — default_camera_hal::Camera / ::CameraHAL symbols and .name
#     "Default Camera HAL" (CameraHAL.cpp:177).  It is NOT the device camera
#     HAL: that one is vendor/lib{,64}/hw/camera.mt6755.so and is still listed.
#
#   lib/libaudiospdif.so
#     A13 builds system/media/audio_utils/libaudiospdif into
#     system/lib/libaudiospdif.so — the same path, and on the default linker
#     path, so audioserver would link a 2015 build.  FACT: the blob exports
#     android::SPDIFEncoder (_ZN7android12SPDIFEncoder...).  There is no
#     lib64 counterpart in the dump, and none was listed.
#
#   vendor/lib{,64}/mediadrm/libdrmclearkeyplugin.so
#   vendor/lib{,64}/mediadrm/libmockdrmcryptoplugin.so
#     A13 builds both from frameworks/av/drm and installs them to
#     vendor/lib{,64}/mediadrm/ — the same path.  FACT: clearkeydrm::DrmFactory
#     symbols plus "ClearKey CDM", and the mock plugin's "mock-*" parameter
#     strings; the 32-bit mock plugin is byte-identical (md5
#     679f4ea821ca33531585fba8249121b5) to the one in the meizu_m6 and M6T
#     dumps — one AOSP reference build shipped across the whole Meizu MTK
#     line.  libwvdrmengine.so (Widevine) is NOT in this group and stays:
#     A13 builds no Widevine.
#
# GROUP 2 — AOSP HALs whose A13 copy lands in /vendor, i.e. in a directory
# that is searched BEFORE the blob's.  hw_get_module tries /odm/lib*/hw, then
# /vendor/lib*/hw, then /system/lib*/hw (hardware/libhardware/hardware.c:39-45,
# 178-190), and the effect loader walks /odm, /vendor, /system in that same
# order (frameworks/av/media/libeffects/factory/EffectsConfigLoader.c:97,100).
# So these can only ever be loaded when A13's own copy is missing — dead
# weight, and dead weight of the kind that hides a missing module.  10 lines:
#
#   lib{,64}/hw/audio.primary.default.so   .name "Default audio HW HAL"
#       hardware/libhardware/modules/audio/audio_hw.c:621
#   lib{,64}/hw/audio.r_submix.default.so  .name "Wifi Display audio HAL"
#       hardware/libhardware/modules/audio_remote_submix/audio_hw.cpp:1671
#   lib{,64}/hw/audio.usb.default.so       .name "USB audio HW HAL"
#       hardware/libhardware/modules/usbaudio/audio_hal.c:1957
#   lib{,64}/hw/audio_policy.stub.so       .name "Default audio policy HAL"
#       hardware/libhardware/modules/audio/audio_policy.c:345
#   lib{,64}/soundfx/libaudiopreprocessing.so  "Audio Preprocessing Library"
#       frameworks/av/media/libeffects/preprocessing (A13 installs it to
#       vendor/lib{,64}/soundfx/)
#
# FACT: each of the ten carries the verbatim .name of the AOSP source quoted
# next to it and "GCC: (GNU) 4.9 20150123 (prerelease)" — MediaTek's 2015
# build of AOSP code, not MediaTek code.  The real MT6755 HALs are separate
# entries and stay: vendor/lib{,64}/hw/audio.primary.mt6755.so,
# audio.r_submix.mt6755.so, audio.usb.mt6755.so, camera.mt6755.so.
#
# KEPT ON PURPOSE (checked, not assumed):
#   lib64/hw/fingerprint.default.so — "Goodix Fingerprint HAL", DT_NEEDED
#     libgf_hal.so + libgf_ca.so, 129088 bytes.  AOSP's own fingerprint.default
#     is the "Demo Fingerprint HAL" (hardware/libhardware/modules/fingerprint/
#     fingerprint.c:120), so this is the real sensor HAL — the same file the
#     m95, m5s, meizu_m6 and M6T dumps carry.  A13 does build its demo HAL
#     into vendor/lib{,64}/hw/, i.e. one directory earlier in the search
#     order; that is a reason to move this blob to /vendor when the vendor
#     tree is generated, not a reason to drop it.
#   lib/hw/audio_policy.default.so — 100112 bytes, reads
#     /system/etc/audio_policy.conf and /vendor/etc/audio_policy.conf.  A13
#     builds no audio_policy.default at all, so nothing is overridden.
#     HYPOTHESIS: dead on A13 because AudioFlinger stopped dlopen()ing the
#     legacy policy HAL long before 13; falsifiable by grepping the blob set
#     for a dlopen of that name.  Left in place until someone does.
#   vendor/lib{,64}/libfs_mgr.so, vendor/lib{,64}/libperfservicenative.so,
#   vendor/lib/libbt-vendor.so — REJECTED as audit hits.  They do show up in
#     installs-lineage_m95.mk, but the module behind them is
#     device/meizu/m95/shims (stem: "libfs_mgr", stem: "libperfservicenative",
#     libm95shim_btvendor) — m95's own shim tree leaking through the root Soong
#     namespace, not AOSP source.  That leak is closed by the
#     soong_namespace {} added to every Meizu device/vendor tree on 2026-09-16
#     (see Android.bp in this directory).
#
# SCOPE.  This file is still an inventory: there is no vendor/meizu/m681
# makefile tree in this workspace, so nothing here is copied anywhere yet.
# The audit is therefore preventive — it stops extract-files.sh /
# setup-makefiles.sh from re-importing the collisions the moment that tree is
# generated.
#
# UNRELATED HYGIENE NOTE (FACT, not acted on): 122 of the 1002 entries in this
# file are literal duplicates of another line (1002 lines, 880 distinct
# paths) — an artefact of mt6755_tree_stage.  Harmless for
# PRODUCT_COPY_FILES, noise for every reader; left alone here so that this
# commit stays one theme.
